payload.description_html: Distribution of dinosaur skeletal fossil records in Korea, including Doolysaurus huhmini from Aphaedo. Colored silhouettes and labels indicate valid taxa, whereas question-marked silhouettes in black represent uncertain or invalid taxa. Silhouettes of sauropods, early-diverging neornithischians, and theropods are from http://phylopic.org.
